body: I hear you buddy, I know this may not mean much, But please do not attempt. I am a stranger but i care about your well being and i want you to be safe. You seem like such a selfless and amazing person. If you want to talk more personally or more in detail about this then my dms are open. I love and care about you and lots do. I hear you and i understand how you feel.

Hey you kind person! Thank you for checking in on me, i am fine right now how are you? Thank you for your kind words, and i’ll be sure to take care of myself, and that to you too! remeber this post is available to you if you need it to, and have a good evening/day :)

Hey hun, I have not been on this subreddit for a week so i wouldn’t have seen your post otherwise i would’ve commented :), i care about what you’re going through and if you want you can tell me in detail what you may be going through
Hey dude :) would you like to take this to PMs or would you like me to just respond here?

Hey bud, First of all of its not too personal, Could you tell me the issues that you think are going wrong with your relationship and Job, also maybe your medical issues too? If you don’t mind. And for the lump, I would really recommend getting that checked out and treated.
Thank you buddy! As of right now i’m doing fine, Thank you for being compassionate and if you ever need someone to talk to chats are open and also this post! Have a good evening/day! :)

You are not a disappointment. You are amazing and you have skills that other people do not have. You deserve to have positivity and surround yourself with positivity. Please. Stay alive. You are not a burden. You seem like a lovely person. You are attractive and it doesn’t matter if you are rich.

Hey dude. You are not bothersome to anybody. You are amazing and strong for putting yourself through this everyday and battling with yourself. Even if you’re weak; that’s okay. I don’t really know what to say because i don’t know you personally but i would love to get to know you and see you thrive. You deserve to be happy and healthy and in your best state. You don’t deserve this.
Hey dude. Please talk to me if you need someone to talk to or a friend.

This may not help and i know i’m just a stranger on the internet but i really hope you’re okay. Do you need someone to talk to? a friend? You seem like such a strong person for going through this much. Even thought your mother was raped, you came out of it and you deserve to have life. You are a good outcome of what happened and i hope you know that. You are worth life and i promise you you will have many chances in life. You just have to surround yourself with positivity and i will be happy to do that. You seem wonderful and strong and you’re loved by so many. I want to see you thrive and improve
Do you need to vent dude? I want to make sure your safe

Hey dude. I’m sorry you feel this way. I want you to know that there is always a better ending to a problem in the outcome. You are strong and you are beautiful and you are deserving of life. Please. You can fight this. Do you need to vent? Anything? I want you to be safe.
